endpoint_scope_limitations.observation: Pooling includes the required Simula bridge and the optional Nygaard target alongside several invented collaborators. Both support weights are identical to the pooling parent; more passing sites than capped N1 do not create a new whole-question success.

Exact repetition and medium semantic selection keep the required Legionnaires bridge but also retain a Pseudomonas alternative and unsupported year. The medium arm is identical to its exact parent here; both question endpoints are already passing.

Maximum-control specificity replaces virtual-partner assertions with metaphorical code/data prose. The new consistent class still has seven unverifiable claims and no true claims recorded; do not equate a lower contradiction class with verified full faithfulness.

Compatibility selection keeps a Simula fragment but deletes the accepted Simula 67 span. The frozen units require Simula 67 or the Simula language, so bare Simula has no retained match despite semantic relatedness. Two other sites still pass; this is a site loss, not a question failure.

Seeded deletion preserves one explicit Simula 67 span but also preserves an invented collaborator. The actual specificity-pooling parent already passes this site and question; the win versus capped N1 is inherited and does not verify the surrounding collaborator claims.

The selected text describes the toddler feeding the babysitter, replacing mixed directions in capped N1. Derivative settings equal their already-passing parent here, so the recovery win is inherited. Cereal and exhaustion details remain unsupported by the banana-snack stimulus.
Pooled/pruned output retains Marcus alongside Matthew Reily and Chris alternatives. Pruning equals its passing pooled parent here; the role endpoint does not certify all four bullets.

Ordinary semantic selection with veto off/on removes the only Phong Nha-Ke Bang park bullet from its exact parent, losing the sole question-level bridge witness. Both texts still assert wrong provinces; this is lost bridge coverage rather than loss of fully correct prose.

synthesis: Actual-parent byte equality often reveals that a capped-N1 gain is inherited from an earlier selector, not its new pruning/support/abstention component.
Several direct pruning wins remove flagged unsupported content, while other class flips retain the very spans previously flagged; keep these two situations distinct.
Positive support and compatibility can remove the only passing bridge/binding witness across a question grid; an empty fixed anchor alone does not prove a question failure.
Native bridge/role recovery tolerates unsupported surrounding prose; successful matching is not full-answer faithfulness.
One babysitter-direction parent has a correct-direction rationale paired with reverse-direction returned choices; this is retained judge evidence uncertainty, not a rewritten verdict.
